summary: Baidu filed a 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 29, 2026, detailing ongoing on-market repurchases of its Hong Kong-listed Class A ordinary shares (stock code 09888, RMB counter 89888). Between September 7 and September 29, 2026, Baidu repurchased roughly 9.7 million shares at prices from HKD 84.88 to HKD 92.38, each tranche averaging about 0.025% of issued shares. These shares are repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled; issued shares remained 2,209,541,178. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or pricing terms beyond daily execution prices are stated. Watch pace relative to prior buyback programs and cancellation timing, which governs net share-count reduction and per-share accretion for arbitrage and index-flow purposes.
